lastCompletedStory.title: Pin hardcoded full-string argv goldens in backend-adapter.test.ts

nextStoryContext: US-001 rewrote every golden test in test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts to assert ClaudeAdapter.buildSpawnArgv(actor, opts) toBe a hardcoded literal argv string, captured by actually running the adapter (scratch `bun -e`/tmp script) rather than invented. The four builder-wrapper imports (buildImplementerWorkerArgv/buildPlannerWorkerArgv/buildAuditorWorkerArgv/buildReviewerWorkerArgv) and their call sites on the expected-side were removed entirely; only ClaudeAdapter is imported now. The two adapter-level guard tests (throw when taskPrompt/permissionMode missing) were left verbatim. Gotcha (already documented in patterns.md around CAM-339/341): a file-assert oracle grepping for builder names/paths matches doc-comment PROSE too, not just import/code lines -- had to rephrase the header comment to describe the four wrapper functions without naming them literally, since AC1's oracle is `! grep -Eq 'buildImplementerWorkerArgv|buildPlannerWorkerArgv|buildAuditorWorkerArgv|buildReviewerWorkerArgv' test/supervisor/backend-adapter.test.ts`. No src/ file touched. All quality gates (typecheck, bun test x5029, check:all spine incl. lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md) passed clean, no budget raises needed.
